hotels.description: Soak up the serenity of Bali’s Umalas region from this tranquil retreat. Conveniently located between happening Canggu and bustling Seminyak, the lavish hideaway is set among tropical landscaped gardens with masterfully designed pool villas that blend traditional Balinese touches with modern stylings. Begin each morning on the famed surf breaks of Canggu before returning for a sumptuous breakfast, then indulge in holistic wellness treatments at the nearby spa. This is your idyllic base for exploring one of Bali’s hidden gems, offering a charming mix of rice fields, boutique cafes and simple charm. Visit sacred temples at the Ubud Monkey Forest or enjoy the area's best beaches. As night falls, venture to bustling Seminyak or bar-hop at the likes of Mrs Sippy Bali and Potato Head Beach Club.
